Bar, dot, box, and raincloud plots of group means with significance brackets

Source: R/plots.R
cr_plot_means.Rd

From a clean_regress() result, plots model-estimated marginal means (averaged over other predictors, with the model's robust SEs) and labels brackets with the same adjusted contrasts the tables report. From a data frame, plots raw means with SE, SD, or CI and labels brackets with Welch t-tests (cr_ttest()).

Usage

cr_plot_means(
  x,
  dv,
  variable,
  by = NULL,
  facet = NULL,
  type = c("bar", "dot", "raincloud", "box"),
  uncertainty = c("ci", "se", "sd", "none"),
  p = c("stars", "value", "none"),
  comparisons = "ref",
  ref = NULL,
  show_values = NULL,
  points = FALSE,
  ref_line = NULL,
  lines = NULL,
  palette = NULL,
  style = "nature",
  digits = 2,
  adjust = "holm",
  conf_level = 0.95,
  caption = FALSE,
  labels = NULL,
  level_labels = NULL
)

Arguments

x

A clean_results object or a data frame.

dv

Outcome.

variable

Grouping variable on the x-axis.

by

Optional second grouping variable: dodged groups in the lab palette. Brackets then compare by levels within each variable level.

facet

Optional variable to facet by (brackets stay within panels).

type

"bar", "dot", or, for raw data, "raincloud" (density, box, jittered points, mean and error bar) or "box".

uncertainty

Error bars: "se", "ci" (default), "sd" (raw data only), or "none".

p

Bracket labels: "stars" (with "ns"), "value" (p = .031), or "none" (no brackets).

comparisons

Which brackets: "ref" (each level vs. ref), "all", "sig" (only significant pairs), a character vector such as c("Loss vs. Control"), or "none". P-values always come from the full set of pairwise comparisons with the model's correction (or adjust for raw data), so they match the tables and text.

ref

Reference level for comparisons = "ref" (default: first level).

show_values

Print the means (above bars; beside dots). Default: on for bars.

points

Raw data, dot plots: show the jittered observations behind the means.

ref_line

Optional y value for a dashed reference line (e.g. a scale midpoint).

lines

Connect dots across x within each by group (interaction style). Default: TRUE for dot plots with by.

palette

Palette name or colors (see cr_palette()).

style

Theme style passed to theme_cr().

digits

Decimal places for printed means.

adjust

Raw data only: correction across pairs.

conf_level

Confidence level for "ci".

caption

Put the method note under the plot. It is always available as attr(plot, "cr_note") for a figure caption.

labels, level_labels

Display labels (raw data); model results use their own labels.

Value

A ggplot object.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
cr_plot_means(res, "trust", "condition")                    # model means, 95% CIs
cr_plot_means(res, "trust", "condition", by = "female", type = "dot")
cr_plot_means(d, "trust", "condition", type = "raincloud") + ggplot2::ylim(1, 7)
} # }
